plans.headline: Kids Discover Nature: Fall Leaves Fall at Harris Lake County Park

main.why: A naturalist leads 2–6 year olds on a short hike to find fallen leaves, reads Fall Leaves Fall, and makes a leaf craft — all outside at Harris Lake County Park.
tips: Registration is required; book ahead of time.
Dress in layers and bring a water bottle; the hike is gentle but it is November.
Leave the park by 12:00 so you are home for lunch before nap.
